title: Show HN: Homegames. An open-source game platform I've been making for 8 years
summary: Homegames is an open-source game platform developed over 8 years where all games are built as JavaScript classes with fully readable source code. It features an in-browser editor allowing users to create, publish, and play games directly from the browser without any installation required.
problem_solved: Makes game development and sharing accessible to everyone by providing a transparent, open-source platform with browser-based creation tools.
why_valuable: It democratizes game creation with fully open source games and zero-barrier-to-entry development tools directly in the browser.
